entities.name: Imprisonment of the Eldrazi
entities.description: Ancient event in which Ugin, Nahiri and Sorin trapped the Eldrazi titans on Zendikar.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: Nahiri's home plane where the Eldrazi were trapped.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: Dragon planeswalker who inscribed the hedrons with draconic runes.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: Planeswalker who built the hedron network.

entities.description: Planeswalker who drained the Eldrazi's strength.

events.summary: Ugin, Nahiri and Sorin devise a plan to trap the Eldrazi on Zendikar; Nahiri builds the hedron network, and Ugin inscribes them.
events.quote: Nahiri was the one to build this intricate structure.

events.summary: Nahiri warns Zendikar's inhabitants as the Eldrazi approach.
events.quote: Nahiri warned the inhabitants of her plane

events.summary: The Titans Ulamog, Kozilek and Emrakul arrive on Zendikar.
events.quote: Ulamog , Kozilek , and the towering Emrakul descended upon Zendikar

events.summary: The three planeswalkers fight the Eldrazi, then combine magic at the Eye of Ugin to activate the hedrons, imprisoning the Titans.
events.quote: Every hedron on Zendikar shifted into place, sealing the Titans in a prison of mana and stone.

events.summary: The three lock the chamber with a spell only three planeswalkers together could break.
events.quote: a spell only three planeswalkers together could break

relations.note: Built the network, shaping hedrons from living stone.
relations.quote: Nahiri was the one to build this intricate structure.

relations.note: Worked together to trap the Eldrazi.
relations.quote: Ugin , Nahiri , and Sorin Markov prepared thoroughly to trap them
